newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan retenders for 15,000 T rice on September 24.
newsitem.headline: Jordan retenders for 15,000 T rice on September 24.

text.p: Jordan has postponed a tender for 15,OOO tonnes of medium grain camolina rice to September 24, pinning hopes on reduced prices of Egyptian rice for November shipment, traders said on Friday.

They said offers for the rice must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by September 24 in two 7,500 tonne lots. The first lot is to be delivered by November 15 and the other by end of November.

The tender, originally set for Sept 18 with shipment for October, was postponed after the Ministry of Supply had offers in the $470-$480 per tonne range for late season Egyptian rice, considered too high. U.S. rice offers were all above $500 per tonne level, traders said.
The ministry, which wants Egyptian rice primarily for its subsidy programme, is betting on new crop being available for November at around $440 per tonne.
Jordan's consumption of rice is 80,000-90,000 tonnes annually.
